questions.question: What role should the principles-and-decisions v0.4 doc play in the remote-store repo?

options.label: Research, then RFC (Recommended)
options.description: Commit it as a point-in-time research doc under sdd/research/. A following RFC selects which definitions and criteria become binding and in which existing homes (ADR template, /observe loop, 000-process doc types). Keeps rationale out of authority docs and leaves the text as written.

options.label: Authority doc directly
options.description: Rewrite it into Intent & Scope, Rules, Guides as a sibling of SPEC-DESIGN.md. Fastest to bind, but its rationale and references must move elsewhere, it costs process budget, and it binds before any trial.

options.label: Stays outside the repo
options.description: Keep it in your research repository as a general reference; this repo only links to it. Nothing binds here, and the seven decision homes stay as they are.

questions.question: What should I do next with the v0.4 doc?

options.label: Trial on repo records (Recommended)
options.description: Apply P1 to P7 and D1 to D7 to a small sample (for example CLAUDE.md principles, ADR-0048's decisions, a few OP-01 decisions) and report where the rubric discriminates and where it does not. Report only; tests the doc before anything binds.

options.label: Full review of the text
options.description: A finding-by-finding review of v0.4 itself: definitions, criteria overlap, examples, claims against sources. Improves the doc but does not show whether it works on real records.

options.label: Draft the missing parts
options.description: Propose additions for the three gaps: the boundary between principle, rule, clause and axiom; quality of a collection of decisions; an independence test taken from the axiom method. Extends the doc before it has been tried.

questions.question: What should I do next with the v0.4 doc?
Which part of my read of the principles-and-decisions v0.4 doc do you disagree with?

options.label: Placement came too early
options.description: I asked where the doc lives and what binds before we agreed on what it says and whether my read of it is right. We discuss content first; no repo role is chosen yet.

options.label: Dropping the axiom link
options.description: I withdrew my analogy between axioms and principles after reading the doc. You do see a relation between the axiom work and principles or decisions, and I should not have dropped it.

options.label: The shortfalls list
options.description: One or more of my seven points misreads the doc or judges it against the wrong yardstick, for example measuring a general reference against this repo's specific pains.

options.label: My reading of your goal
options.description: My restatement of what you want (one vocabulary for what a principle and a decision are and how to write them, for this repo) is off, so the whole read aims at the wrong target.
